_note: Cultural value pool (§8) — 2-3 per species. `eventNote` is the hook event logic keys off (Phase 2 authors events against these ids).

values.name: Honor-Debt
values.eventNote: remembers rescues and betrayals for the whole run

values.name: Knowledge-Hoarding
values.eventNote: pays for secrets, never shares its own

values.name: Ancestor Worship
values.eventNote: graves and relics are sacred; disturb them at your peril

values.name: Ritual Combat
values.eventNote: disputes settle by duel; produces Duelist recruits

values.name: Radical Hospitality
values.eventNote: guests are sacred — abusing hospitality is unforgivable

values.name: Purity Taboos
values.eventNote: cybernetics and relic tech offend; scars are read as corruption

values.name: Oath-Binding
values.eventNote: spoken promises are contracts; breaking one is exile-worthy

values.name: Trophy-Taking
values.eventNote: respect is earned in visible kills; weakness invites raids

values.name: Consensus-Seeking
values.eventNote: decisions take time; patience opens doors force cannot

values.name: Debt-of-Water
values.eventNote: sharing scarce supplies creates kinship bonds
